subject: Global listing: evidence timeline, support window mapping, and trademark footprint
body:
From: marketplace-ops@aws-partner.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: susan.lee@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 11 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify 24x7 claim and regional support windows for AWS listing

Hi Laura,

Quick follow from our intake team as we prepare the public listing for Acme Health. Two items that need confirmation before we proceed to listing QA:

1) Support SLA language: Acme requested "24x7 enterprise support" on the listing. We need an operational mapping of which timezones/regions this covers (UTC offsets) and the on-call rotation evidence (pager contacts or support matrix).

2) Trademark usage: the draft listing uses Acme's trademarked logo and product name in the header and tag line. Legal flagged a footnote requirement for markets in the EU and APAC — can you provide the trademark authorization PDF or guidance on permitted modifications?

Attachments: support_matrix_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

We can hold the listing if necessary but prefer to resolve both items by next week.

Appreciate the speedy help —
Marketplace Ops (AWS Partner)

---

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: marketplace-ops@aws-partner.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com, susan.lee@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 14 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify 24x7 claim and regional support windows for AWS listing

Thanks — good questions. Short answers up front: we can support 24x7 for US/EU/APAC with regional routing; trademark authorization is available; we need to confirm a small footnote for localized trademark marks in the EU.

Proposed next steps and timeline (mutual action plan):
- Today (Aug 14): I’ll attach our current support matrix and the trademark authorization (redacted) to this thread. Ben, can you confirm the rotation schedule that maps to UTC offsets?
- Aug 15: Connor to provide a one-pager describing escalation SLAs (P1/P2 response windows) that we can include in the partner evidence bundle.
- Aug 16: I will send final wording for the marketplace support claim and the EU footnote for legal sign-off.

Ben / Connor — flag anything that will block the Aug 16 cut. Susan — adding you so you can approve the fine-grained wording before we publish.

Attachments: listing_evidence_onepager.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

---

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Aug 2028 08:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify 24x7 claim and regional support windows for AWS listing

Laura / team — see inline. I pulled the rotation from our ops pager and converted to UTC windows.

- Americas: 00:00-08:00 UTC (overnight local coverage + 2 on-call engineers)
- EMEA: 08:00-16:00 UTC (primary regional engineers, follow-the-sun overlap)
- APAC: 16:00-00:00 UTC (local on-call + regional handoff)

Escalation targets (from Connor's draft): P1 response <30min, P2 response <4h, P3 acknowledgement <24h.

I attached the support matrix with contact placeholders and an ops note about burst capacity for high token throughput (relevant for Acme). No blockers for the Aug 16 handoff.

Attachment: support_matrix_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

- Ben
Principal Customer Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

---

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marketplace-ops@aws-partner.com
Cc: susan.lee@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify 24x7 claim and regional support windows for AWS listing

Attaching an evidence one-pager that outlines the escalation flow and a short note for marketplace reviewers that clarifies the difference between "24x7 monitoring" and "24x7 engineer response." Please quote the precise wording below when you publish: 

"Redwood provides 24x7 monitoring and regional on-call engineering with regional response objectives. For customers with enterprise support contracts (listed on the partner listing), 24x7 engineer response is available per contractual terms; standard listings will indicate monitoring and business-hours primary response. See escalation matrix in the evidence bundle."

I also added the recommended EU footnote for trademark usage: "Where local trademark restrictions apply, the listing will display the Acme product name only; the Acme logo will appear on request after legal confirmation."

Attachment: trademark_usage_guidance.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: listing_evidence_onepager.pdf (pdf)

Connor O'Brien
Head of Platform Reliability (Partner Integrations)
Redwood Inference

---

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: marketplace-ops@aws-partner.com
Cc: susan.lee@acmehealth.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify 24x7 claim and regional support windows for AWS listing

Thanks all — summarized final deliverables below for the listing QA team and legal: 

- Support claim copy to publish: "24x7 monitoring with regional on-call engineering (enterprise customers may enable 24x7 engineer response by contract)."
- Operational evidence: support_matrix_v2.xlsx (attached), escalation one-pager (attached).
- Trademark evidence: trademark_usage_guidance.pdf (attached) and DocuSign authorization link: DocuSign: 0x9f3b-listing-evidence-signature.
- EU footnote to include on listing: "Trademark usage subject to local controls; logo displayed upon verified authorization."
- Action: Marketplace Ops — please confirm that the above copy and attachments satisfy QA. Susan — please confirm final acceptance from Acme by EOD Aug 17 so we can publish on Aug 20.

If there's anything else, flag it here.

Best,
Laura
